correctness.rationale: The assessment used finite intersection-rank signatures to compress the acceptance LP and then reused the modular uncrossing and chain-feasibility argument.

originality.rationale: The assessment treated the arbitrary-field online formulation as absent from the motivating manuscripts.

value.rationale: The stated contribution was removal of the finite-field restriction in the online representation model.
